chapter: Trent's band: Arkansas, Dallas and the Adolphus
title: Meeting Trent through Eugene Cook and a summer drug store job
summary: Cook hears his swing solo at a parade and hires him; the band plays for tips outside a drug store in Arkansas until his mother sends the police.

story.theme_name: First paying gigs: getting started as a young professional
story.community_name: First paid gigs: pay, bands and young beginnings

blocks.x: SO HOW DID THE THING COME UP WITH... HOW DID YOU GET TO JOIN... UGH... HOW DID YOU COME TO MEET FRED. WAS FRED ALREADY KNOWN IN LITTLE ROCK?
Well-, I ran into a guy, Eugene Cook.
MY BUDDY, YEAH!
(Laughing.) Well- Eugene Cook. Ugh-
HE HAD A BAND OF HIS OWN DIDN'T HE?
Trent was with him.
TRENT WAS WORKING WITH HIM.

With him. Cook heard me play. We did a parade out at sweet home and somebody pointed this guy out to me. This guy had a band and I decided that my life wasn't going to be made with this band; so I put my X-notes in there. I played, I played, I played. I put my things in there. When it got down to solo, I played me a swing solo. Which Mr.
Cook didn't like it all. But I didn't care because I wanted to impress Cook, and obviously I did because he hired me to come into the band and we went down to Hellener, Arkansas.
We were playing at a drug store.
A drug store.
Well-, what happened, he gave us a certain amount of money. In other words he guaranteed our food and lodging, and then we got most of our extra money as a service through the hat.
Sometimes we played out on the sidewalk right in front of the drug store.
This was day time, yes.
HOW LONG DID THAT GO ON?
That went on for at least a couple of months.
YEAH.
Yeah.
THIS WAS WHAT IN THE SUMMERTIME PROBABLY?
It was summertime.
HOW MANY PIECES WERE IN HIS BAND?
I think he had six. He had six in the band.
-------WAS ON THE PIANO AND YOU AND COOK PLAYING BANJO, WHO WAS THE DRUMMER, WAS G-------THE DRUMMER.
No Gottlieb wasn't the drummer at that time. He had ------ cousin, I forget the guy's name, was his drummer.
DID YOU HAVE A TRUMPET PLAYER OR SAXOPHONE PLAYER?
You know I don't remember exactly what----but I do remember, yeah he did have a trumpet player.
THIS LASTED A COUPLE OF MONTHS, RIGHT?
It only lasted a couple of months because it was toward the end of the summer and I was supposed to go back
to school and I said the heck with school, I wanted to play, that was what I wanted to do. So my mother sent the police down then.
TO DRAG YOU BACK.
To drag me back.
